output.subject: We've received your complaint about your visit to our Cold Spring Rd branch
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us and for taking the time to tell us what happened. We want to confirm that we have received your complaint.

You told us that on 9/5, staff at our Cold Spring Rd branch would not cash your payroll check unless you showed two forms of ID. You mentioned that the customer ahead of you, a white man, was able to cash his check without showing any ID, and that you believe you were treated differently because you are Black. You also told us that you then went to a check cashing store and paid an $18 fee to cash your check there.

We understand how upsetting this experience was, and we are sorry for the distress it has caused you. We take what you have described seriously. A specialist team is reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you in writing within 10 business days, as you asked.

Thank you again for bringing this to our attention.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer asked for a written response; confirm the delivery method and mailing or email address on file.
The complaint is a contact-center summary of a call; confirm the details (date, branch, ID requested) match the customer's own account.
Confirm the year of the 9/5 visit before referencing it.
The customer alleges racial discrimination; make sure the reply is coordinated with the specialist team reviewing it.
The customer reports paying an $18 fee elsewhere but did not explicitly request reimbursement; decide whether to address it.
The draft does not comment on branch ID requirements for cashing checks; add specifics only once reviewed.
